name: Eductive_Polar_Defense
display_fullname: Incarnate Hybrid Eductive Aux Eductive Polar Defense
display_help:
Eductive Core Hybrid combined with a defensive Tier 4 Radial Lore has yielded this potent shield, reflecting the unique energy signature of the creatures you conjured. The shield stretches over a 120 foot radius, affecting yourself and up to 31 additional allies. Up to three shields of a kind will stack. You must have your Eductive Hybrid ability toggled on to sustain the shield. If your Eductive Hybrid deactivates, or if your Radial Lore support pet returns to the Well, the benefits will soon be lost.

Eductive Core Hybrid and Radial Lore can combine to create the following effects:
Cimerorans: +12% Smashing/Lethal Defense
Longbow: +12% Energy Defense
Banished Pantheon: +12% Negative Energy Defense
Demons: +12% Fire Defense
Polar Lights: +12% Cold Defense
Carnival: +12% Psionic Defense
Nemesis: +8% Melee Positional Defense
Arachnos: +8% Ranged Positional Defense
Storm Elementals: +8% Area Positional Defense
Rikti: +8 Mag Hold Protection
War Works: +8 Mag Sleep Protection
Seers: +8 Mag Stun Protection
Phantoms: +8 Mag Terror protection
Robotic Drones: +8 Mag Knockback Protection
IDF: +30% Regeneration Debuff Resistance
Clockwork: +30% Recharge Debuff Resistance
Knives: +30% Defense Debuff Resistance
Rularuu: +30% To Hit Debuff Resistance
Tsoo: +30% Recovery Debuff Resistance
Talons: +30% Damage Bonus
